prompts: List my Calendly meetings for this week.
Show what my next invitee answered on the booking form.
Find open 30-minute slots next Tuesday for my intro call.
Create a single-use scheduling link for my intro call.
requirements: A Calendly account on any plan, including the free plan.
limitations: Calendly allows 50 API requests per user per minute on the free plan and 500 on paid plans, including calls from this app.
Free and trial plans can create only 5 invitees per user per day through the API.
Routing form tools need a Calendly Teams plan or higher.
This app does not start automatic monitoring from its MCP connection alone.
